recommendations.title: AWS Credentials Exposed
recommendations.description: Found 2 AWS keys. Immediately rotate these keys. Use IAM Roles for EC2/Lambda, or environment variables. Never commit AWS keys to version control.

recommendations.title: Google API Keys Exposed
recommendations.description: Found 1 Google API keys. Ensure these keys have referrer/IP restrictions configured in the Google Cloud Console. If these are backend keys, move them to environment variables.

recommendations.title: Stripe Keys Exposed

recommendations.title: Hardcoded API Keys
recommendations.description: Generic API keys found. Move all secrets to environment variables (.env files) or a secure secrets manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).

recommendations.title: Hardcoded Credentials
recommendations.description: Found 5 potential passwords or usernames. Hardcoding credentials poses a severe security risk. Rotate passwords immediately and use environment variables.

recommendations.title: Unsafe DOM Manipulation
recommendations.description: Detected usage of 'innerHTML' or 'outerHTML'. This can lead to DOM-based XSS. Use safer alternatives like 'textContent', 'innerText', or DOM creation methods (document.createElement).

recommendations.title: Dangerous Code Execution
recommendations.description: Detected usage of 'eval()' or 'new Function()'. This is extremely dangerous and allows arbitrary code execution. Refactor code to avoid dynamic evaluation. Use JSON.parse() for JSON data.

recommendations.title: Deprecated DOM Methods
recommendations.description: Detected usage of 'document.write()'. This is poor practice and can be dangerous. Use modern DOM manipulation methods instead.

recommendations.title: Unsafe React Pattern
recommendations.description: Detected 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML' in React. Ensure content is sanitized using a library like DOMPurify before rendering.

recommendations.title: Missing Content Security Policy
